hook: Akvan delays two Howrah-bound trains from Hyderabad today
hook_b: Akvan delays two Howrah-bound trains from Hyderabad today
tldr: South Central Railway rescheduled two express trains on Thursday because of Cyclone Akvan. The East Coast Express (18046) leaves Charlapalli at 3.40 pm and the Falaknuma Express (12704) leaves Secunderabad at 5.55 pm.

beats.what: SCR rescheduled the Charlapalli–Shalimar East Coast Express and Secunderabad–Howrah Falaknuma Express for Nov 19.
beats.why: Cyclone Akvan is affecting the east coast route these trains take towards Howrah.
beats.care: Passengers booked on 18046 or 12704 today need to check the new departure times.

causes.label: Cyclone Akvan on the east coast

facts.t: The Charlapalli–Shalimar East Coast Express now leaves *7 hours* after its usual 8.40 am slot.

viz.verdict: Both trains leave later the same day
